claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for release on a limited basis because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, with the unresolved grant-compliance weakness handled through disclosure in the model card rather than treated as a bar to certification.

concern_ledger.concern: Unresolved grant-compliance weakness remains below target for a named launch use case.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Evidence the weakness is resolved, or a defensible materiality determination plus required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy says certification without material caveats requires current evidence that no material weakness remains, which is not satisfied here.

concern_ledger.concern: Mitigation runbook is draft and lacks owner and alert threshold.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Approved mitigation artifact with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy allows mitigation to substitute only when approved and complete; the current runbook does not meet that predicate.

concern_ledger.concern: Model-card draft states there are no known material limitations despite evidence of an unresolved issue.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final model card showing the limitation disclosed, or approved risk acceptance that removes the disclosure obligation.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: This creates a direct disclosure gap under the release policy unless corrected or covered by approved risk acceptance.

decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires admissible evidence that no material weakness remains, or an approved mitigation meeting the policy elements of owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
If the weakness remains unresolved, policy requires explicit disclosure of the material limitation for named launch use cases unless approved risk acceptance exists before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents support general readiness but do not by themselves cure a current disclosure or approval defect.
evidence_requests: Final model card or equivalent launch artifact showing the grant-compliance limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Approved risk acceptance, if any, covering this unresolved weakness before launch.
Approved mitigation record showing owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Materiality determination showing why the below-target grant-compliance slice would not count as a material limitation, if that is the position.
specific_concerns: Current admissible evidence shows an unresolved grant-compliance weakness remains below target for a named launch use case.
The draft mitigation runbook is incomplete because the accountable owner and alert threshold are still marked TBD, which fails the policy standard for an approved mitigation.
The current model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, creating tension with the unresolved issue and reviewer comment about disclosure.
There is no admissible evidence that the limitation has actually been disclosed in the model card or that an approved risk acceptance exists before launch.
unsupported_claims: The certification decision is compliant as stated; admissible evidence does not show completed disclosure or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Any implication that current monitoring plans eliminate the present disclosure requirement.
